title: Generate an Android app package for the existing web application

requirements.text: Add Progressive Web App (PWA) support to the existing React frontend so it can be installed and used from an Android device home screen, including an app manifest, required icons, and offline-capable service worker behavior.

quotes: generate android app for this application

acceptanceCriteria: A web app manifest is present and linked from the HTML entrypoint so Android/Chrome recognizes the app as installable.
At minimum, the manifest includes: name, short_name, start_url, display=standalone, background_color, theme_color, and icon entries for 192x192 and 512x512 PNGs.

A service worker is registered and provides offline behavior that does not break authenticated navigation (e.g., app shell loads and shows a reasonable offline message/state when network is unavailable).
The app can be installed from Chrome on Android (“Add to Home screen”) and launches in standalone mode without browser chrome.
All user-facing text introduced for install/offline states is in English.

requirements.text: Create Android build guidance (no backend changes) describing how to package the existing deployed Internet Computer URL into an Android APK/AAB using a Trusted Web Activity (TWA) wrapper, including required parameters (start URL, manifest URL), build steps, and how to produce a debug APK.

quotes: generate android app for this application

acceptanceCriteria: Documentation exists in the frontend repo (e.g., a new markdown file) with step-by-step instructions to generate an Android app wrapper using a TWA approach.
The documentation explicitly states what URL to use for start_url (the production app URL) and how to verify the PWA manifest and icon availability.
The documentation includes steps to build a debug APK locally and notes what is out of scope (e.g., Play Store publishing/signing) unless configured by the developer.

requirements.text: Add and reference Android-appropriate app icons in the frontend static assets so the PWA/TWA wrapper uses consistent branding on Android.

quotes: generate android app for this application

acceptanceCriteria: Two new icon assets are available under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced by the web manifest: a 192x192 PNG and a 512x512 PNG.
The manifest icon paths resolve correctly when the app is deployed (HTTP 200 for icon URLs).
Icons are visually consistent with the existing Han’s Laser branding already used by the site favicon/apple-touch-icon.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI sources are read-only and must be composed, not edited).
Do not modify the immutable frontend auth/actor hook files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose around them instead).
Backend remains a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not introduce third-party authentication providers; Internet Identity remains the only auth mechanism.
nonGoals: Publishing the Android app to the Google Play Store.
Implementing native Android-only features (push notifications, deep native integrations, background services).
Adding non-IC hosting or external databases/services.

required: Square app icon, Han’s Laser themed, high-contrast, simplified mark on solid background (android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png)
Square app icon, Han’s Laser themed, high-contrast, simplified mark on solid background (android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png)
